origin.description: Extract the rightmost literal match from each string.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector of strings to search.

origin.details: Search starts from the end, so the last match can overlap an earlier one. The extracted text keeps the original case. No match, an empty string, an empty pattern, or a missing value yields NA. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
origin.value: A character vector. NA means there was no match.
origin.example:
found <- stri_extract_last_fixed("agAGA", "aga", case_insensitive = TRUE)
cat(paste0('stri_extract_last_fixed("agAGA", "aga", case_insensitive=TRUE) returns ', found, '.\n'))

translation.description: Extract the rightmost literal match from each string.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Literal pattern, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: opts_fixed
arguments.text: None, or a dict of search settings. Overlap is ignored.

arguments.name: case_insensitive
arguments.text: If given, match the simple uppercase of each code point.

arguments.name: overlap
arguments.text: Ignored. The last match is the rightmost one.

translation.details: Search starts from the end, so the last match can overlap an earlier one. The extracted text keeps the original case. No match, an empty string, an empty pattern, or a missing value yields NA. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
translation.value: A list of strings and NA. NA means there was no match.
translation.example:
from stringi.fixed import stri_extract_last_fixed
found = stri_extract_last_fixed("agAGA", "aga", case_insensitive=True)
print(f'stri_extract_last_fixed("agAGA", "aga", case_insensitive=True) returns {found[0]}.')
